posts.text:
Americans want secure elections.
Americans want secure borders.
Americans want fiscal responsibility and fraud rooted out.

As Dems nominate radicals, GOP should lean into that contrast..but we have to do more than talk about our priorities.

We have to act. We have to deliver. And we have to give the American people a reason to trust us with their vote.
posts.summary: Criticizes Democratic nominees as radical, calls GOP to contrast and deliver on priorities
